text.text_excerpt: Very clean hostel. Their happy hour is almost too good to be true. There is also a street car right across the street from here! It will take you where you need to go.

Awesome! I will never stay in a hotel again! I met so many people. The staff are amazing, informative and helpful. There's a bar in the lobby and a happy hour from 7-8 with $2 and $3 drinks. Location is walking distance to the French Quarter, or if you prefer, the St. Charles streetcar stop is right outside. For $1.25 per trip or $3 for a 24 hour period you can ride any streetcar or bus. There's a bike rental place around the corner for $20/24 hrs. Highly recommend. Breakfast is included in your stay at The Quisby. Place has a very cool vibe and is super clean. If you buy food you can store it in the fridge, if you need toiletries or a hairdryer, they have that, too. You also get towels. ...

Amazing people, lovely hostel, a haven from the chaos of a literal pandemic during a strange and scary time. I checked-in to the Quisby after getting kicked off my college campus, desperate for a last chance at freedom before several months of isolation in impossible-to-walk suburbs. Given the circumstances, I wasn't expecting to be having the time of my life. But the $2 wells during Happy Hour gave me a chance for social interaction that (probably) won't kill someone, and I met some really cool people in my couple days there. Location was great for hopping on the streetcar up to the French Quarter or the bus down to Magazine Street. Right next to a Popeye's, but walk about fifteen minute...
